title: WORKPRO 12-in-1 Ratcheting Multi-Bit Screwdriver Set, Quick-load Mechanism Screwdriver with Double End Bits in Handle

reviews.title: Premium for Cheap
reviews.body: I used this screwdriver within an hour of Amazon dropping off the package and it feels very nice in the hand and has A LOT of heft. It won't be replacing my Klein Tools ratcheting screwdriver, but it will be garage workhorse replacement for a previous multibit screwdriver that rusted.I was afraid that the way that the bits were held in, could cause some to slip, but so far no worries. The mechanism to select rotation is smooth, satisfying, and sturdy; especially compared to the Klein. I didn't even realize that the bits were magnetized when purchasing, so I was surprised with my first usage and they have a good "grab" of screws.Due to the nature of how the bits are stored, the handle is longer than the Klein, but still makes the Workpro's overall package a tiny bit smaller. For the price (versus the Klein, when on sale), this is a great alternative and look forward to using it a lot, in the garage.Read moreRead less

features: [What You Will Get]: 1 PC Screwdriver Handle with 6PC Double-ended Bits, 1/4 inch hex shank S2 steel bits, length 3-1/2 inch. Stored in handle for convenient access and carry: shafts SL4/5, PH1/PH3, SQ2/PH2, SQ3/SQ1, T10/T15, T20/T25
[Superior Ratcheting Mechanism]: Ratchet design breaks through the limitations of the direction, convenient switch for forward and reverse ratcheting and locking position, saves time and effort
[Quick-load Design]: Patented auto-locking, quick-load ratchet mechanism provides a one-handed bit loading lock
[Ergonomic Handle]: Slip-resistant grip for comfortable holding and higher torque output. Features with ergonomic handle, reduce hand labor during use
[Applications]: The 12-in-1 ratchet screwdriver set is suitable for DIY, home repair, and outdoors, which meets your needs of multi-purpose. Store all included bits inside the handle, easy for EDC
